launches.name: Sputnik 1
launches.summary: First artificial satellite. 58 cm sphere beeping from orbit for 21 days.

launches.name: Vostok 1
launches.summary: Yuri Gagarin becomes first human in space with a 108 minute orbit.

launches.name: Apollo 11
launches.summary: First crewed Moon landing. Armstrong and Aldrin walk on the Sea of Tranquility.

launches.name: Voyager 1
launches.summary: Grand tour probe now in interstellar space, farthest human made object.

launches.name: STS-1 Columbia
launches.summary: First orbital flight of the reusable Space Shuttle program.

launches.name: Hubble Deployment STS-31
launches.summary: Hubble Space Telescope deployed, transformed deep field astronomy.

launches.name: Zarya ISS Module
launches.summary: First module of the International Space Station launched.

launches.name: Orbcomm OG2 Flight 20
launches.summary: First orbital class booster landing back on land.

launches.name: James Webb Launch
launches.summary: Infrared successor to Hubble sent to Sun Earth L2.

launches.name: Artemis I
launches.summary: Uncrewed Orion loop around the Moon, first SLS flight.

launches.name: Starship IFT-2
launches.summary: Second integrated test, hot staging proved, lost before orbit.

launches.name: Chang e 6
launches.summary: First sample return from the far side of the Moon.
